conbody.p: If the driver takes their hands off the steering wheel for several seconds, the warning message will appear and an audible warning will sound in stages.

li.p: Warning message: Keep hands on steering wheel
Second stage: Warning message (red steering wheel) and audible warning
Warning message: HDA (Highway Driving Assist) system. canceled

conbody.p: If the driver still does not have their hands on the steering wheel after the hands-off warning, the warning message will appear and Highway Driving Assist will be automatically canceled.

note.p: When 'Emergency Stop (ES)' is equipped, the emergency stop function will activate if you do not continue to hold the steering wheel.
For more information, refer to the “Emergency Stop (ES)” section in this chapter.
